# Sign in
{: .no_toc }

Exchange email + password for a session, or start an MFA challenge.
{: .fs-6 .fw-300 }

| | |
|---|---|
| **Screen ID** | `AUTH-01` |
| **Route** | `/sign-in` · deep link `substratal://sign-in` |
| **Who can use it** | Unauthenticated |
| **Kind** | auth |
| **Available in** | All Hub apps (MVP) |
| **On Linux** | Separate `AdwWindow` with `AdwClamp` |

**How you get here:** App launch with no stored session; Session expired / revoked (preserves `?next=` destination); Sign out

## What's on this screen

| Element | What it is | Shows / does | Rules | On Linux |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Email | email-field | body.email | required; RFC 5322; trim; autofill username | AdwEntryRow input-purpose=email |
| Password | password-field | body.password | required; reveal toggle; autofill current-password | AdwPasswordEntryRow |
| Sign in | primary-button | POST /auth/login | disabled until both fields non-empty | GtkButton .suggested-action .pill |
| Forgot password? | link | → AUTH-05 |  | GtkButton .flat / GtkLinkButton |
| Create an account | link | → AUTH-03 |  | GtkButton .flat / GtkLinkButton |
| Continue with SSO | button | POST /auth/sso/{provider}/callback | hidden behind flag `sso` (API returns 501 today) | GtkButton |
| Sign in with a passkey | button | — | hidden behind flag `passkeys`; reserved for when the API supports WebAuthn | GtkButton |

## What happens when you act

| Action | API call | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Sign in | `POST /auth/login` | 200 AuthSession → store tokens → go to `next` or APP-01. 200 MfaChallenge → AUTH-02 with mfa_token. |
| — |  | 401 → inline form error "Email or password is incorrect." (never reveal which). 403 → account suspended/locked message; `test_user_expired` → "This test account has expired." 429 → disable button, countdown from Retry-After. |

## Good to know

- **Loading, empty and error states:** Submitting: button spinner, fields read-only; Locked out (5 failures / 15 min): explain wait time
- `test_mode` is never exposed in end-user UI; developer builds may show a hidden toggle (long-press logo / ⌥-click) for test-mode sign-in. The horizontal logo lockup (BrandLockup, `brand/BRAND.md`) sits above the form.
